task.description: Diagnose ISS-0150 / GH #482: zig build test-integration-svc exits 1. Determine why a tenant schema is reachable without its per-tenant schema_migrations ledger. Read the code; do not guess. Write docs/issue-reports/ISS-0150-diagnosis.yaml.
acceptance_criteria: Root cause of tenant_<uuid>.schema_migrations does not exist identified
docs/issue-reports/ISS-0150-diagnosis.yaml written with root cause(s) and fix plan

result.summary: Reported root cause disproven. The three tenant_<uuid>.schema_migrations does not exist lines are stderr bleed from a concurrent sibling binary, captured inside the output block of TC-ISS503-01 whose real failure is error.FileNotFound. Per-tenant ledger tables are intentionally absent (canonical tracker is public.schema_migrations per src/design/iss504_migration_tracking.md; GBL-132 deliberately drops stray per-tenant copies). Tenant provisioning is not defective. Three genuine independent root causes identified instead: RC-1 GBL-084 -> GBL-123 migration rename left a stale filename in test_iss503_rls_removal.zig; RC-2 xc05/xc06 fixtures target a nonexistent `instances` table with wrong column names; RC-3 six OIDC test files write unqualified INTO tenant and hit a stale tenant_default shadow copy lacking tenant_type. Also established that the shared bpm_test DB carries a permanent migration-ordering artifact (1134 applied 43 min before GBL-128) producing 4 phantom failures, so all counts must be taken on freshly migrated databases.
